quests.title: The Old Passage
quests.text: Kharim's letters speak of a passage beneath one of the abandoned mines east of the ridge. Find it before the Shariw do.

quests.title: A Scholar's Price
quests.text: Kharim will share what his maps show, for 3000 gold.

quests.title: The Cursed Eye
quests.text: Bring Kharim the Cursed Eye of Set from the Collapsed Shrine in the southern ruins.

quests.title: Hold the Desert
quests.text: Hold three mines at once to prove the Compact can protect Kharim's work.

say: Kharim
Gold buys ink, and ink buys truth. Listen closely.

offers.label: Hand over the Cursed Eye of Set

say: Kharim
The Eye! The priests who carved it drew the old tunnels in its iris. Here...
Ushari
Khemret is ours, commander. The men are restless; they came for gold, not sand.
Ushari
Kharim's letter says a passage lies beneath one of the old mines past the ridge. Find it, and the Compact reaches Pha'raxh first.
Ushari
Recruit in Khemret, take the mines, and keep an eye on the eastern dunes.
Ushari
Bones hold the pass. Thirty at least, and scorpions behind them.
Ushari
We could force it now, but we'd bleed for it. More spears from Khemret first.
Ushari
There: an abandoned shaft, sealed with old stone. Kharim spoke of four such mines.
Ushari
The dead guard them all. Only one leads down.

quest_text: Search the four old mines. One of them hides the passage; the others hold only dust or danger.

say: Scout
Tharakh, commander. Walls half-buried, no banner. Its well still runs; take it and it will feed us recruits.
Scout
Riders on the eastern dunes. Veiled, fast, gone before we could count them.
Ushari
Shariw. This is their desert. They know about the old mines, and they want them sealed.
Ushari
A week gone. If the Shariw reach the passage first, they will bury it forever. We must move faster.
Ushari
The ford is the only way across the canyon, and the dead are thick there.
Ushari
Riders and knights, commander. Levies alone won't carry that crossing.
Messenger
A rider from Kharim's camp, commander! He has seen your banners and begs you to visit.
Kharim
The Compact! At last, someone with enough swords to test my theory.
Kharim
The histories say Pha'raxh fell in a day. They lie. Its people went down. Beneath.
Kharim
My maps can rule out the false mines, if you help me. Gold, the Eye of Set from the southern shrine, or proof you can hold this desert.
Kharim
Three mines under Compact banners! You can hold a desert after all. A promise is a promise.
Ushari
An eye of red glass, cold as a grave. Kharim will want this.
Scout
Ain Sharu, the Shariw stronghold. Their riders come and go from it like bees from a hive.
Kharim
Three debts paid, three mines struck from my list. You have earned more than a clue, commander.
Kharim
I am coming with you. Someone must read the walls when we go down.
